Description.Name: Max Tiger
Description.Details: Max Tiger is an oddity. Little is known of his background, as he never really talks much - unless its old war stories. He lives for the thrill of battle and thrives in the cockpit. When it comes to 'Mechs, his perspective is "the bigger the better". Tiger is only ever happy when he's pushing his 'Mech to its limits. Outside of combat, he always seems restless, constantly eager for the next fight, and the next epic story.
